articles.title: Treasuries Slide After Strong Jobs Data Lift Fed Hike Wagers
articles.summary: US Treasuries fell after US job growth topped forecasts in August, prompting traders to nudge up expectations that Federal Reserve officials raise interest rates later this month.

articles.title: Risk Assets Can Withstand Fed Rate Hike, BlackRock's Rosenberg Says
articles.summary: Jeffrey Rosenberg, portfolio manager of the systematic multi-strategy fund at BlackRock, says a 25 basis-point rate hike would not be a big issue for risk assets. He speaks on "Bloomberg Surveillance." (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: Emerging-Market Currencies Post Longest Winning Run Since 2007
articles.summary: An index for emerging-market currencies headed for a tenth successive week of gains, its longest winning streak since 2007, even as a blowout US jobs reported briefly jolted global markets on Friday.

articles.title: Senegal Debt Plan Exposes BOAD, AFC to Credit Risk, Citi Says
articles.summary: The West African Development Bank, or BOAD, the African Export–Import Bank, the Africa Finance Corp. and Ecobank Transnational Inc. are the most exposed to corporate credit risk under Senegal’s planned debt treatment, according to Citigroup Inc.

articles.title: Jobs Report Is More About Inflation, BlackRock's Rosenberg Says
articles.summary: Jeffrey Rosenberg, portfolio manager of the systematic multi-strategy fund at BlackRock, says the August US employment report is much more about inflation and Federal Reserve monetary policy. He speaks on "Bloomberg Surveillance." (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: Inflation Data, Not Jobs, to Dictate Next Fed Move, Economist Roth Says
articles.summary: Stephanie Roth, chief economist at Wolfe Research, says, “the hawkish price action may be taking the print a little too far,” as she examines economic and monetary policy signals from the US August jobs report. (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: Italy Extends Diesel Tax Cuts to Shield Voters from Price Hikes
articles.summary: Italy will extend a tax cut on diesel fuel prices until Sept. 10, as Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni’s government continues to shield consumers ahead of a general election expected next year, according to an Italian official.

articles.title: August Jobs Report Favors a Fed Rate Hike, Sahm Says
articles.summary: Claudia Sahm, chief economist at New Century Advisors, reacts to the US employment report for August. She says this jobs report favors Federal Reserve officials that want to start hiking rates. She speaks on "Bloomberg Surveillance." (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: US Stock Futures Slip as Jobs Growth Fuels Fed-Hike Bets
articles.summary: US stock futures erased early gains to briefly touch session lows on Friday after the US added 162,000 jobs in August, raising concerns that the Federal Reserve may hike interest rates soon.

articles.title: Copper at Risk of Rare Supply Decline as Mine Setbacks Mount
articles.summary: Copper has been on a record-breaking tear in the past year, driven largely by tariff-related trade flows. Bullish investors are betting that flatlining mine supply will drive prices even higher.

articles.title: Anti-Drone Firm APS Said to Mull Options Including Possible Sale
articles.summary: Polish anti-drone company Advanced Protection Systems is in the early stages of exploring strategic options, which may include a potential sale, people with knowledge of the matter said.

articles.title: German Power Prices Fall to Lowest Since June on Strong Wind
articles.summary: German day-ahead power prices fell to their lowest level since June amid strong wind generation, creating an unusual price gap with neighboring France.

articles.title: German Pension Reform May Raise €90 Billion a Year, Apollo Says
articles.summary: Germany’s historic pension overhaul could increase annual inflows into the system’s three pillars by €90 billion ($105 billion) annually, according to Apollo Global Management Inc. European Economic & Policy Strategist Huw van Steenis.

articles.title: Fidelity Mandates Five Days in Office as it Opens New Boston Home
